name: Condition
description: Condition was an annual furry convention held in London, Ontario, from 2010 to 2014, organized by Forest City Media & Entertainment. It was created out of a wish for an Ontario-based convention after others in the area, such as C-ACE, had ended. Its concept was to take the idea of a convention theme to its extreme, with an overarching storyline linking each edition through stories, skits at the opening and closing ceremonies, podcasts, an interactive spy game and an assassin game with Nerf guns. The top registration level, the Story Arc Sponsor, was written into the story. The charity auction, hosted by Kamber Lane, ended with a ladder auction, and the convention supported the Salthaven Wildlife Rehabilitation and Education Centre. Five editions were held.
